brand: Bibulu kuma bɛɛ ɲasɔrɔ siɲɛ kelen
docTitle: Bibulu ja kan · Bibulu kuma bɛɛ ɲasɔrɔ siɲɛ kelen
metaDesc: Layidu Kɔrɔ waatiw, Yezu ka ɲɛnamaya, ani Pɔli ka taamaw ɲini ja yɛrɛyɛrɛ kan — Bibulu koow kɛra yɔrɔ yɛrɛyɛrɛw le la.

s.kicker: Bibulu kuma bɛɛ ɲasɔrɔ siɲɛ kelen · Jaw
s.title: Bibulu ja kan
s.verse: “An ye Yezu Krista, an Matigi ka setigiya n'a ka nako min fɔ aw ye, o te siirin koo ye dɛ! Nga anw yɛrɛ ɲaa lara a ka nɔɔrɔ kan.” (Piyɛri 2nan 1:16)
s.purpose: Bibulu tɛ nsiirin ye. A ye mɔgɔw ka sɛbɛnni ye minw taamana yɔrɔ, don ani tɔgɔ yɛrɛyɛrɛw kan. O siraw ɲini ja kan, waati sira fɛ — yɔrɔ dɔ digi, walima ▶ digi ka taama a kan senɲɛ kelen kelen.
s.ot_h: Ka bɔ danni na ka se Zeruzalɛmu kɔseginni ma
s.ot_lead: Taama kelen tɛ, nga kisili tariku woyoli ka bɔ danni na: danni ni binni → sanjiba ni Babɛli → weleli (Ibrayima) → jamana layidulen → Ezipitibɔ → kongokolon → jamana sɔrɔli → masaya → farali → jɔnya → kɔseginni.
s.je_kick: ② Layidu Kura — Yezu ka ɲɛnamaya
s.je_h: Ka bɔ Bɛtileyɛmu na ka se Zeruzalɛmu ma
s.je_lead: Yezu ka ɲɛnamaya ɲini Kibaru diman ka fɔcogo la, a sira fɛ — ka bɔ a mɔgɔyali la Bɛtileyɛmu, ka tɛmɛ a ka batisimu ni a ka baara la Galile, ka Samari cɛtigɛ, ka se kuruwa, kununni ani yɛlɛnni ma Zeruzalɛmu.
s.pa_kick: ③ Layidu Kura — Pɔli ka taamaw
s.pa_h: Ka bɔ Antiyɔsi ka se diɲɛ daan ma — Ɔrɔmu
s.pa_lead: Ka bɔ Pantekɔti la Zeruzalɛmu, Kibaru diman jɛnsɛnna cogo min na ka tɛmɛ Zude kan — ka Azi Fitini ni Erɔpu cɛtigɛ ka se masaya jusukun ma. Taama duuru la kelen sugandi (fɔlɔ·2nan·3nan + taama ka taa Ɔrɔmu + bilali kɔ) ka Kɛwaliw ka koow ɲini ni bataaki minw sɛbɛnna sira kan.
s.foot: Sɔrɔyɔrɔw · Yɔrɔw be tugu Bibulu kuma ni Bibulu dugukoloko lɔnnen na (ni bi tɔgɔw ye yɔrɔ minw be dɛmɛ di). Kɔgɔ daaw, baw ani kɔw bɔra dugukoloko kunnafoni dayɛlɛlen (Natural Earth) na, a nɔgɔyalen.
s.contact: Ɲininkaliw · hakililaw — Email ci an ma

eden.name: Edɛn (Danni · Binni)
eden.today: bii Tigɛri ni Efɛrati baw cɛmancɛ
eden.note: Diɲɛ min dara ka ɲi kosɔbɛ, hakɛ donna a la ka jɛɲɔgɔnya tiɲɛ min tun be Ala ni mɔgɔw cɛ.
events: Danni tile wɔɔrɔ kɔnɔ — “a ka ɲi kosɔbɛ”
Mɔgɔ dara Ala ja la
Binni, ani gwɛnni ka bɔ Edɛn na
Kibaru diman ka layidu fɔlɔ — “muso ka deen bena saa kungolo ɲɔɲɔ”

noah.name: Ararati (Sanjiba)
noah.today: bii Ararati kulu, Turki kɔrɔn fɛ
noah.note: Ala be diɲɛ min falen hakɛ la kiti, nga a be ɲɛnamaya mara denbaya kelen barika la.
events: Diɲɛ falen tiɲɛni na
Sanjiba, ani Nowe ka kurun
Sankaba ka layidu — “sanjiba tɛ na tugu ka diɲɛ halaki”

babel.name: Babɛli sanbaraso
babel.note: Ka ɲɛsin yɛrɛboɲa ma min be a bolo se sankolo ma, Ala ye u kanw ni siyaw jɛnsɛn dugukolo kan.
events: “An ka dugu ni sanbaraso jɔ… an ka tɔgɔ sɔrɔ”
Ala ye u kanw ɲagami
Siyaw jɛnsɛnna dugukolo kan (Sineari — kɔfɛ Babilɔni)

ur.name: Uri
ur.note: Bibulu ka kisili maana be daminɛ ni cɛ kelen weleli ye.
events: Ala ye Ibrama wele ka bɔ Kalde ka Uri la
“Ne bena i kɛ siya belebele ye… siyaw bɛɛ bena hɛrɛ sɔrɔ i barika la”
Lanaya barika la a bɔra a faso la

haran.name: Harani
haran.note: Sira kan, weleli jaabili la ka taa jamana layidulen fan fɛ.
events: Tera ka denbaya sigira Harani
Tera sara
Ibrama wulila ka taa Kanaan a si san 75 la

shechem.name: Sikɛmu · Kanaan
shechem.note: Jamana layidulen na, denbaya dara ani layidu be tɛmɛ bɔnsɔnw na.
events: Donni Kanaan na, saraka bɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ — “ne bena nin jamana di i kɔmɔgɔw ma”
Layidu (Kod 15) · Izaka · Zakɔbu
Zakɔbu deen tan ni fila — siya tan ni fila jusun

egypt.name: Ezipiti (Goseni)
egypt.note: Denbaya be kɛ siya belebele ye — o kɔ jɔn jama ye.
events: Zozɛfu, feerelen, yɛlɛnna ka Ezipiti mara
Zakɔbu ka denbaya bɛɛ jiginna kɔngɔ kosɔn
Isirayɛli siya jiritɔ kɛra jɔɔnw ye

sinai.name: Sinayi kulu
sinai.note: Layidu Kɔrɔ ka kisili belebele — jɔɔnw be kɛ Ala yɛrɛ ka mɔgɔw ye.
events: Bana tan ani Tɛmɛnnaloon saraga
Kɔgɔji Bilenman farala u tɛmɛna
Sariya Tan, Sariya, batoso ni sarakaw

kadesh.name: Kadɛsi (kongokolon)
kadesh.note: Dannabaliya y'a to bɔnsɔn kelen ye jamana bɔnɛ — nga Ala tora u fɛ.
events: Sɛgɛsɛgɛla tan ni fila — nga jama banna ka la
San 38 kongokolon na — mana, sankaba ni tasuma
Mowabu kɛnɛ kan, Musa ka waaju laban (Sad)

jericho.name: Zeriko
jericho.note: A laban na u donna jamana layidulen na k'a sɔrɔ.
events: Zurudɛn farala jama tɛmɛna
Zeriko kogow binna
Kanaan sɔrɔli ani jamana tilali

shiloh.name: Silo (Cɛfariw)
shiloh.note: Masacɛ tɛ yen, bɛɛ b'a sago kɛ — masacɛ yɛrɛyɛrɛ mago be yen.
events: Batoso sigira Silo
Hakɛ–ɲangili–kisili kuruba (Debora, Zedeyɔn, Sansɔn)
Uru — kantigiya waati dibilen na, Dawuda bɔnsɔn na

jerusalem.name: Zeruzalɛmu · Masaya kelennin
jerusalem.note: Isirayɛli ka waati ɲuman — ani masacɛ banbali ka layidu.
events: Masacɛ fɔlɔ Sayuli, o kɔ Dawuda ni Goliyati
Dawuda ka layidu — “i ka masasigilan bena to tuma bɛɛ” (Sam 2nan 7)
Solomani ye batoso jɔ Zeruzalɛmu

samaria.name: Samari · Masaya farannen
samaria.note: Masaya farala ka jigin k'a sɔrɔ kiraw be kule.
events: Solomani kɔ, farali Zuda ni Isirayɛli ye
Bolifɛnbato senɲɛ caaman
Eli, Eza, Zeremi be kule “aw ye segi” — ani u be Masaya koo fɔ

nineveh.name: Ninivi (Asiri)
nineveh.note: Lasɔmini si ma minɛ, kɔgɔdugu binna fɔlɔ.
events: Ninivi, Asiri faaba
Kɔgɔdugu masaya binna Asiri bolo (I.ɲ. 722)
Yɔnasi cira Ninivi

babylon.name: Babilɔni
babylon.note: Su ko dibinba — nga jɔkura layidu be to yen.
events: Zeruzalɛmu binna, batoso jenina (I.ɲ. 586)
Zuda tara ka taa jɔnya la Babilɔni
Daniyɛli ni Ezekiyɛli — lanaya ni yeliw jɔnya la

susa.name: Suzi (Pɛrɛsi)
susa.note: Hali bolifɛnbato masaya jusukun na, Ala be a ka mɔgɔw mara.
events: Pɛrɛsi ye Babilɔni gosi
Ɛstɛri ye Zuwifuw kisi halakili ma
Neyemi ye deli kɛ masacɛ ɲakɔrɔ, a cira

return.name: Zeruzalɛmu kɔseginni
return.note: U seginna ka jɔkura kɛ — nga masacɛ ma na fɔlɔ. U be Masaya makɔnɔ.
events: Kɔsegi siɲɛ saba Sirisi ka cidaa fɛ (Zorobabɛli 538 · Ɛsidirasi 458 · Neyemi 444)
Batoso jɔkura ani Zeruzalɛmu kogow dilankura
Mal — Layidu Kɔrɔ be ban: “N bena n ka ciden ci”

bethlehem.name: Bɛtileyɛmu
bethlehem.note: Masaya layidulen be na Dawuda ka dugu la — Kuma kɛra mɔgɔ ye.
events: Wolola Bɛtileyɛmu, Dawuda ka dugu la
Mɛlɛkɛw ye kibaru fɔ sagagɛnnaw ye
Dɔnnikɛlaw nana ka batoli kɛ

nazareth.name: Nazarɛti
nazareth.note: Ala mɔna i n'a fɔ mɔgɔ dugu gwansan dɔ la.
events: Mɔna jiridɛsɛla ka soo la
A si san tan ni fila la, a be ɲininkali ni jaabili kɛ batoso kɔnɔ
Kɔfɛ a banna a faso ka sinagɔgi la

jordan.name: Zurudɛn baji
jordan.note: A ka baara foroba be daminɛ — sankolo b'a sɛmɛntiya ko Dencɛ.
events: Zan y'a batize
Nii jigira i n'a fɔ ntubannin — “Nin ye ne Dencɛ kanulen ye”
A ye Sutana ka kɔrɔbɔli saba dama kongokolon na

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: A ka taamasiɲɛ fɔlɔ la a y'a ka nɔɔrɔ yira.
events: Dunan kɔɲɔ dɔ la
Ji yɛlɛmana ka kɛ diwɛn ye — a ka taamasiɲɛ fɔlɔ
A ka kalandenw dara a la

sychar.name: Sikari (Samari)
sychar.note: Baara daminɛ sira — ka tɛmɛ Zeruzalɛmu ka taa Samari mafiɲɛyalen na.
events: A ye batoso saniya Zeruzalɛmu
Su fɛ, Nikodɛmu — “Wajibi don i ka wolo kokura”
Ji ɲɛnama Samari muso dɔ ye

capernaum.name: Kapɛrnaumu
capernaum.note: Galile baara faaba — weleli, kalan ani sɔsɔli bɛɛ be ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ yan.
events: A ye jɛgɛminɛnaw wele k'a sigi yan
Kulu kan waaju — “Dubaden lo minw ye faantan ye u nii la”
Masaya ntalenw — ani sɔsɔli be wuli

galilee.name: Galile kɔgɔ
galilee.note: Ni sebagaya ye danfɛnw kan a b'a yira mɔgɔ min a ye.
events: “Sumaya, i ka je” — a ye fɔɔnɔba sumaya
A ye mɔgɔ waa duuru balo ni buru duuru ni jɛgɛ fila ye
A taamana ji kan

caesarea_p.name: Sezare Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Kalandenw y'a faamu ko Krista lo, ani kuruwa sira dayɛlɛla.
events: Piyɛri ka seereya — “I ye Krista ye, Ala ɲɛnama Dencɛ”
A ye a ka saya ni kununni koo fɔ siɲɛ fɔlɔ
A yɛlɛmana ni nɔɔrɔ ye kulu kan

jericho.name: Zeriko
jericho.note: Sira kan ka yɛlɛn Zeruzalɛmu, a be tununnenw ɲini.
events: A ye ɲɛ di fiyentɔ Baritime ma
A ye nisɔngɔ minɛna Zake wele
“Mɔgɔ Dencɛ nana tununnenw ɲini ka u kisi”

bethany.name: Betani
bethany.note: A ka dɔgɔkun laban ɲa, a b'a yira ko a ye saya matigi ye.
events: A ye Lazari lawuli ka bɔ kaburu la — “Ne le ye kununni ni ɲɛnamaya ye”
Mariyamu ye tulu kɛ a la a suko kama
Nin taamasiɲɛ y'a fagali feere sabati

jerusalem.name: Zeruzalɛmu
jerusalem.note: Bibulu bɛɛ be ɲɛsin yɔrɔ min ma — kuruwa, kununni, yɛlɛnni.
events: Donni ni nisɔndiya; a ye batoso tabaliw yɛlɛma tugu
Surɔfana laban na a ye kalandenw seenw ko
A sara kuruwa kan
A kununna tile sabanan loon, o kɔ a yɛlɛnna sankolo la

antioch.name: Antiyɔsi
antioch.note: Cidenya eglisi min be siyaw ka cidenya daminɛ ani a be segi yɔrɔ min na.
events: Deli la, Nii ye Barinabasi ni Sawuli woloma
Eglisi min na dannatigiw welela “kerecɛnw” fɔlɔ
Taama fɔlɔ, 2nan ni 3nan wuliyɔrɔ

seleucia.name: Selesi
seleucia.note: Antiyɔsi ka kurundon — u ye kurun ta ka taa Sipri.

salamis.name: Salamin (Sipri)
salamis.note: Sipri jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ — waajuli sinagɔgiw kɔnɔ.

paphos.name: Pafɔsi
paphos.note: Sebagaya b'a yira minw be Kibaru diman kɛlɛ.
events: Subaga Elimasi kɛra fiyentɔ ye
Gɔfɔrɔnɛri Sɛrɛziyusi Pɔlusi dara a la
Ka bɔ yan “Pɔli” be ɲaminɛ

perga.name: Pɛrigi
perga.note: Panfili kurundon — yan Zan Mariki seginna kɔ.

pantioch.name: Pisidi Antiyɔsi
pantioch.note: Kibaru diman be daayɛlɛ ka ɲɛsin siyaw ma.
events: Kisili tariku waaju janw sinagɔgi kɔnɔ
Siya caaman nisɔndiyara ka Kuma minɛ
Gwɛnna kɛlɛ kosɔn

iconium.name: Ikoniyɔmu
iconium.note: Mɔgɔ caaman dara a la, nga ɲangili y'a to u taara ɲa.

lystra.name: Lisitɛri
lystra.note: U y'a wele batofɛn, o kɔ u y'a bon kabakuruw la.
events: A ye namatɔ dɔ kɛnɛya min wolola ten
Jama y'a ɲini ka saraka bɔ u ye i n'a fɔ alaw
U y'a bon kabakuruw la k'a to i n'a fɔ mɔgɔ salen, a wulila

derbe.name: Dɛrɛbi
derbe.note: Kalanden caaman sɔrɔla; u seginna u kɔ ka eglisiw barikaya.

troas.name: Tirowasi
troas.note: Yɛlɛmayɔrɔ min na Kibaru diman ye a ɲɛsin Erɔpu ma fɔlɔ.
events: Maseduwan cɛ dɔ ka yeli
“Na Maseduwan ka an dɛmɛ”
U tɛmɛna joona ka don Erɔpu

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Erɔpu eglisi fɔlɔ — Kibaru diman be see sɔrɔ hali kaso la.
events: Lidi, forobɔ feerekɛla, dara a la
Filɛlikɛ jɔnmuso dɔ hɔrɔnyara
Sufɛ dɔnkiliw, dugukolo yɛrɛyɛrɛ, kaso kɔlɔsibaga ka denbaya kisira

thess.name: Tesaloniki
thess.note: Kuma be dugu lamaga ani kɛlɛ be wuli.
events: A ye kuma fɔ sinagɔgi kɔnɔ Lafiɲɛbɔn saba
“Mɔgɔ ninnu minw ye diɲɛ bɛɛ ɲagami”
U bɔra su fɛ

berea.name: Bere
berea.note: “Mɔgɔ ɲumanw” minw ye Kuma sɛgɛsɛgɛ u yɛrɛ ma.
events: U ye Kuma minɛ ni nisɔndiya ye
Don o don u be Kuma Senuw sɛgɛsɛgɛ k'a lajɛ
Caaman nana dara a la

athens.name: Atɛni
athens.note: Hakilitigiw ka dugu la a ye “ala lɔnbali” koo fɔ.
events: Dugu falen bolifɛnw na y'a dusukun kunun
Areyopazi kan a ye Dannikɛla ni kununni koo fɔ
U y'a mafiɲɛya, nga dama dara a la

corinth.name: Korɛnti
corinth.note: A ye san kelen ni tila kɛ yen, ka eglisi sigi kojugu dugu la.
events: A be fanibugu dilan ni Akilasi ni Prisiyɛli ye
“Kana siran… bari ne be i fɛ”
Korɛntika caaman dara a la ka batize

ephesus.name: Efɛzi
ephesus.note: Taama 3nan jusukun — Kuma be jɛnsɛn Azi kɔnɔ.
events: Kalan don o don san fila Tiranusi ka kalanso la
Subaga gafew jenina; baara barikamaw
Warijɛ numu Demetriyusi ye murutili wuli

miletus.name: Mile
miletus.note: Efɛzi eglisi cɛkɔrɔbaw ni ɲɛjiko foli.
events: “Aw ka eglisi kɔlɔsi a ye min san n'a joli yɛrɛ ye”
Cɛkɔrɔbaw kasira, k'a lɔn ko u tɛ a ye tugu

caesarea.name: Sezare
caesarea.note: San fila kɔnɔ a ye Kibaru diman kunmabɔ gɔfɔrɔnɛriw ni masacɛ dɔ ɲakɔrɔ.
events: Kiti gɔfɔrɔnɛri Felikisi ni Fɛsitusi ɲakɔrɔ
A ka kunmabɔli Masacɛ Agiripa ɲakɔrɔ
“Ne be Sezari kiti daali” — ka taa Ɔrɔmu

jerusalem.name: Zeruzalɛmu
jerusalem.note: A minɛna batoso kɔnɔ, a ka kaso sira be daminɛ.
events: Jama y'a minɛ batoso kɔnɔ
A y'a yɛrɛ kunmabɔ jɛmukan ɲakɔrɔ
I n'a fɔ Ɔrɔmu jamanaden, a cira ni kɔlɔsi ye ka taa Sezare

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: U yɛlɛmana Alɛkizandiri kurun dɔ kan min be taa Ɔrɔmu.

fairhaven.name: Kurundon Ɲumanw (Krɛti)
fairhaven.note: Pɔli ka lasɔmini ko u ka kurun jɔ, o ma minɛ.

crete.name: Krɛti
crete.note: A bilali kɔ, gun min kan a ye Titi to yen ka eglisiw labɛn.
events: A ye Titi to yen ka cɛkɔrɔbaw sigi dugu bɛɛ la
A ye ɲinini kɛ jalakintan, dannaya ɲɛmɔgɔw koo la
A ye bataaki sɛbɛn Titi ma

malta.name: Malti
malta.note: Fɔɔnɔ ni kurun cɛnni cɛma, Ala ka layidu be sabati.
events: “Kɔrɔn-kɔgɔdugu-fɔɔnɔ” ye kurun cɛn, nga mɔgɔ 276 bɛɛ kisira
Sa y'a cin, nga foyi m'a kɛ
A ye gun banabagatɔw kɛnɛya

syracuse.name: Sirakuzi
syracuse.note: U ye tile saba kɛ Sisili.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: U jiginna Itali, balima dannatigiw y'u kunbɛn.

rome.name: Ɔrɔmu
rome.note: Kibaru diman be se masaya jusukun ma laban — laban tɛ, nga daminɛ lo.
events: San fila soo kaso la, a be Ala ka masaya waaju ni ja ye
Ka bɔ yan a ye Kaso Bataakiw sɛbɛn (Efɛ·Fil·Kɔl·Filemɔ)
Kɔfɛ a donna kaso la tugu, a ye Timɔte 2nan sɛbɛn ka faga — “Ne ye kɛlɛ ɲuman kɛlɛ, ne ye boli dafa”
